audioDescription: Silent preview: no music, voice or sound effects.
limitations: Scene-dependent background: instead of the #EFE4C8 example swatch, the page is a purple-dyed vellum (#3A2340), modelled on the codex purpureus tradition. It is a procedural approximation: a flat field with static seeded SVG feTurbulence speckle and fibre mottling, an edge shade and a displaced darker deckle stroke. It is not a scanned or simulated skin.

BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json reports 0 matched sources and lists no contact sheets, so no source-frame observations were applied. The purple vellum choice is an authored scene decision, not source evidence.
STYLE.json tech.preview_recipes is absent or null, so no reviewed recipe could be demonstrated. The refresh demonstrates the scene-dependent background policy within the primary style.
Gilding is flat #B89B51 with a narrow masked linearGradient sweep. It is not raised gesso, metallic reflectance, bloom or PBR gold.

Contours on the dark page use gold and cream (chrysographic) lines in place of #352D27, which disappears on purple (1.04:1). #352D27 is kept for outlines inside the pigment grounds of the initial and miniature.

Text uses the authored copy from the illustration, set in a system Palatino-style serif in cream #EFE4C8 (11.1:1) and gold #B89B51 (5.25:1) on #3A2340. It is not verified calligraphy. The ruling lines below the rubric stay blank.
The ornament, initial and miniature are original procedural vector art. The page turn and push-in from the full-video plan are out of scope, and the page plane stays fixed. Blender was not used.
Render and browser QA were not run by the agent.
